task.title: To delete a conditional Segment in a template

step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced for Conga CLM (Contracts for Salesforce).
In the Templates pane, go to Work tab, click the More icon () and select Segment.
Select the segment from the segment list. The selected segment is highlighted in the template.
Click the Settings icon () next to the segment name to open the Segment Settings page.
Click Delete Segment. You will see a confirmation message. Click Delete again.

postreq.p: Your segment is successfully deleted and the content control boundary of your segment is removed.
